name.en: Flexible organic OPV film (Heliatek HeliaSol, example)
name.es: Pelicula organica flexible OPV (Heliatek HeliaSol, ejemplo)

description.en: Organic (OPV) triple-junction flexible film, NOT CIGS. Separated from the CIGS entry (flexible_lightweight). Sample label states prototype for testing only. Datasheet and label conflict on bend radius and maximum system voltage; both values are kept as unverified.
description.es: Pelicula flexible organica (OPV) de triple union, NO CIGS. Se separa de la entrada CIGS (flexible_lightweight). La etiqueta de la muestra indica prototipo solo para pruebas. La ficha y la etiqueta difieren en radio de curvatura y tension maxima; ambos valores se conservan como no verificados.

typical_use: Lightweight roofs and curved surfaces; prototype sample.

cell.type: organic (OPV) triple-junction cells in series; not CIGS
cell.note: Datasheet: 'Organic triple-junction solar cells in serial connection'. Cell count not stated; module efficiency is in mechanical_ratings.

layers.name: Front glass
layers.material: none (polymeric film front, UV and weather protected)

parts.name: Front glass
parts.material: none (polymeric film front, UV and weather protected)

parts.name: Frame
parts.note: No frame: film is adhered to the surface.

parts.name: Organic PV film laminate
parts.material: organic film with polymeric front and black back film

geometry.description: Single film element 2000 x 436 x 1.8 mm (solar film, datasheet). Junction box (IP67, front side) size not stated and not modelled. Not a framed module.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module long side, y along short side, z up through thickness; origin at module front-left corner; mm. Here z=0 is the front glass face and z grows toward the rear through thickness.

mechanical_ratings.weight_note: per module; datasheet claims less than 2 kg/m2
mechanical_ratings.prototype_note: Product label: prototype 'for testing purposes exclusively, no commercial use'
mechanical_ratings.status_note: values transcribed from cited datasheets only; status unverified unless marked

unverified_items: Datasheet and product label conflict: bend radius 500 mm (datasheet) vs 200 mm (label); max system voltage 1000 V (datasheet) vs below 50 V (label). Both kept as unverified.
Sample is labelled a prototype for testing; do not treat as commercial product data.
Layer thicknesses not stated individually (only total 1.8 mm).
Not a CIGS entry; the CIGS flexible module is in flexible_lightweight.

sources.title: IEC 61701:2020 publication page (salt mist corrosion testing)
